thread:
zara: Promo to eu-west for ai-ingress v2.7.0 failed preflight: image digest mismatch between registry eu and global mirror. deploy-bot auto-hold. anyone on registry side?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: image-digest-skew, expected sha256:abc123 from manifest, found sha256:def456 in eu-west mirror; action=hold. see registry logs at /var/logs/registry-sync/1749991230

kevin: looks like the image push to eu mirror retried and re-tagged; digest differs. chart was built from pipeline image:sha256:abc123 but mirror has def456.

maya: options: 1) pin eu-west to previous chart v2.6.8 and abort (safe), 2) force promote by overriding image tag to the mirror digest (hotpatch, risky), 3) re-sync mirror to match global digest and re-run promo (needs registry ops help, ~20-40m).

zara: prod must not get the wrong image. prefer pin staging/eu to 2.6.8 and re-sync mirror. we'll schedule a coordinated re-promo after mirror fix.

ops-bot: filing incident INC-2024-874: registry-mirror-digest-skew; assigned to @kevin.

kevin: starting mirror sync now. ETA ~30m. I'll also add a registry-mirror digest check to the preflight CI.

zara: i'm aborting the current promote and pinning eu-west to 2.6.8. @deploy-bot record manual_pin reason.

deploy-bot: action=manual_pin, user=zara, reason="image digest mismatch in eu-west mirror", pinned_version=2.6.8, timestamp=1749991238

kevin: audit commands I'm running:
```
# inspect registry sync
ssh registry-eu -- tail -n 200 /var/log/registry-sync/1749991230.log
# compare digests
skopeo inspect docker://registry.global/redwood/ai-ingress:sha256_abc123 | jq .Digest
skopeo inspect docker://registry.eu/redwood/ai-ingress:latest | jq .Digest
# trigger re-sync
registry-sync --mirror registry.global --target registry.eu --image redwood/ai-ingress:sha256_abc123
```

maya: adding release-note snippet: "EU-West promo to v2.7.0 deferred and pinned to v2.6.8 due to image digest mismatch in regional mirror. Mirror re-sync in progress; re-promo scheduled after verification. CI preflight will include digest parity check."

zara: thanks. will unpin and resume promo once kevin confirms mirror digest matches. :white_check_mark:
